data.exact_reserve_text: The underwriting result includes releases from reserves established in prior years of GBP 52.8 million (2015: GBP 53.8 million).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate closed 2016 with an opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,673.1m (closing 31 Dec 2015). Management reports releases from reserves established in prior years totalling GBP 52.8m in 2016, reflecting favourable prior-year claims development which reduced gross claims liabilities and contributed to the underwriting result. The reported prior year movement was presented in the Managing Agent/Directors' commentary rather than in a single labelled gross movement note in the technical reserves notes available for extraction.
raw_causal_phrases: releases from reserves established in prior years of GBP 52.8 million (2015: GBP 53.8 million)
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (page 9) prior-year column (31 Dec 2015 closing = opening 1 Jan 2016). Prior-year development taken from the Managing Agent/Directors' commentary (page 4) which states releases of GBP 52.8m; it is not explicit in the accessible notes whether this figure is gross or net of reinsurance, and a detailed 'movement in prior year's provision' gross column was not clearly parsed from the technical reserves notes. I therefore treated the stated GBP 52.8m as the best available prior-year movement (interpretation as gross is uncertain). The segmental/regulatory premium mix table was not clearly legible for reliable extraction; gross written premium total was read from the financials (page 8). No claims development triangle was parsed into numeric rows in this extraction (triangle present in report but not reliably OCR'd here). Recommend manual verification of the prior-year movement against the Technical Reserves movement note or the gross claims development table in the PDF.
